text: Sandshaped Dracthyr Battlegear Grips is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Obsidian Dracthyr Battlegear Mail Armor.
Sandals of the Chosen Dead is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Vestment of the Chosen Dead.
Sand Turtles are turtle located on the Coast of Echoes in the Borean Tundra.
Sandra Hope is an inker for World of Warcraft: The Comic by DC Wildstorm written by Walter Simonson along with pencilling from Ludo Lullabi. She is also occasionally a colorist.
Sap is a rogue class talent that incapacitates a single target for up to 1 minute. It is automatically learned for Subtlety.

"Sargeras and the Betrayal" is a section of the History of Warcraft, Chapter I. Found at: * Astranaar in Ashenvale on the floor behind a table. * Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands - Inn * Ratchet in Northern Barrens - Inn Timeline: * ← Previous book: Mythology of the Titans * → Next book: The Old Gods and the Ordering of Azeroth
Sapphiron is the penultimate boss of Naxxramas. As of patch 3.3.0, players no longer need to clear the wings in order to fight Sapphiron. He guards the gateway to Kel'Thuzad's inner sanctum.

Sar'theris Strand is the name of the coast of Desolace. It is heavily populated by sea giants, naga, and makrura. The Karnitol Shipwreck lies off the northern part of the strand, and a small boat lies smashed on the beach below Ethel Rethor. Though Desolace is a grey, gloomy wasteland, the Sar'theris Strand is sunny and grassy. It is off this coast that Sar'theris Striker can be fished for Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme.
You are asked by Hana'zua, a dying troll, to kill the beast he could not, the beast whose stinger inflicted his mortal wound - Sarkoth.

__NOTOC__ Sarilus Foulborne is a Forsaken mage sitting at the top of Dreadmist Peak in the Northern Barrens. He filled the Mystral Lake in Ashenvale with corrupted water elementals. As he was the only undead mage in the Barrens capable of defiling this many water elementals, Sentinel Velene Starstrike wanted his head. While loyal to the Shadow Council, he apparently summoned the water elementals in the name of the Horde. His corruption of the lake survived his fall, and both Horde and Alliance forces had to clean the lake.
Sandstalker Gauntlets is mail hand armor that offers quite some nature resistance for hunters and Enhancement shamans.
Sandstalker Bracers are mail wrist armor that offers excellent Nature Resistance for hunters and Enhancement shamans who are venturing through the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj.
Sara Balloo is a dwarf quest giver located in the Military Ward in Ironforge.
Sarah Sadwhistle was a gnome quest giver located in the Military Ward in Ironforge.
__NOTOC__ Sapphiron's Left Eye is held in the off hand. It is primarily for damage-dealing casters.
__NOTOC__ Sapphiron's Right Eye is held in the off hand. It is primarily for healers.

Sanuye Runetotem is a level 15 leather armor vendor located in Vendetta Point in the Southern Barrens. He was one of the survivors to escape the raid of Camp Taurajo.

The path up to him was in the southwest corner of the excavation.

Sargeron Hellcallers are level 70 elite satyr found in the Arcatraz.

The Sanguine Hibiscus is located in Underbog and drops from bosses and mobs there. These also respawn, making it relatively easy to farm them in an empty instance, at least until the enemies respawn. It also drops from Bog Overlords in the Steamvault, but with much less frequency.
Sara Balloo's Plea is part of the A King's Tribute quest chain.
Sarilus Foulborne's Head dropped from Sarilus Foulborne on Dreadmist Peak in the Barrens.

Sar'this is an arakkoa found at Lake Jorune in Terokkar Forest. He is found here with the Evoker of Sar'this, the Disciple of Sar'this, as well as several Minions of Sar'this. It seems that he has a pact with Illidari Lord Balthas where he gave him his blood, but still seems to owe him a favor. Maybe due to this, he's called a heretic.

The Sapphire Signal Fire can be found in Veil Shalas of Terokkar Forest.

According to Grand Master Siegesmith Corvus, by the time of the third invasion of the Burning Legion, saronite wasn't good enough anymore for the weapons of the Knights of the Ebon Blade.

__NOTOC__ Sarathstra is a mighty frost wyrm patrolling the skies above the Dragonblight. While most of these frostwyrms raised by the Scourge in this region are easily dealt with by Rokhan and his dragon hunters, Sarathstra has proved to be a bit problematic. Rokhan is out of hunters and has been recruiting adventurers to bring down the mighty wyrm.

Saronite Bar is a metal bar made from Saronite Ore, an ore found in higher level Northrend zones. It is used for higher end Grandmaster skill level items, where Cobalt Bar is more typical for lower end Grandmaster skill level items. The bars are cast in the shape of crudely decorated coffins in both their icons and their model when shown in the world.
Saragosa's Corpse can be found on the ground after defeating Saragosa and is a quest objective for Saragosa's End.
Saronite Ambusher is crafted with Blacksmithing (400); taught by Blacksmithing trainers.
Sapphire Hive is a large hive for very large wasps found south of Frenzyheart Hill in the Sholazar Basin. It is home to a colony of blue-hued wasp and their queen.
Saronite Bombs are created though the Box of Bombs in 20-38 in one box. The box itself is crafted with Engineering (405).
Requires Engineering 415 to make. Saronite Arrow Maker is a recipe taught by Grand Master Engineering Trainers. Parts: * Saronite Bar x15
Sapphiron's Demise (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Sapphiron in Naxxramas on 10-player mode.
__NOTOC__ Sarah Chalke is a Forsaken quest giver located at the Sunreaver Pavilion in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. She was present during Death Rising.

Sara is the vrykul avatar of Yogg-Saron who assists players during phase one of his encounter. After revealing her true form, she transforms into a Val'kyr, becoming and attacking players for the remainder of the fight.
Sani'i is a jungle troll trade goods vendor located just outside Conquest Hold in the Grizzly Hills.
Sanut Swiftspear is a taunka poison and reagents vendor located at Camp Oneqwah in the Grizzly Hills.
Saree is a Zandalari troll alchemy vendor found at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

Sapphiron's Lair is the lair of Sapphiron located deep within Naxxramas, guarding the inner sanctum of Kel'Thuzad. Pre-patch 3.3.0 you had to clear each final boss of the four separate wings to access this portion of Naxxramas, but that has been changed since.
Sarhule the Risen is a skeletal mage vendor found in the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.
Sarah Brady is a gnome vendor found in the Circle of Wills in the Underbelly of Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, she was cowering in fear.

Sanguine Chamber is an area inside Sunwell Plateau. The chamber is a circular den that is colored blood red due to the lighting of the floating blood crystals hovering in the room, it is passed during the gauntlet run of the Dead Scar and is where some groups of felblood can be found lurking.
The Saronite Gargoyle Cloak can be looted after winning the Gunship Battle in the 10-man version of Icecrown Citadel.
__NOTOC__ Sapphire Hive Queen is a giant wasp found in the Sapphire Hive in Sholazar Basin.

Sarcen Stone is contained in Ancient Stone Cask in Lake Mennar in Azshara. It is an arcane stone charged and used by the night elf mages of Mennar Academy during the War of the Ancients to redirect ley lines, trying to draw energy away from the Well of Eternity, which the Burning Legion was using to invade Azeroth. After being used, Archmage Selwyn sent Kalytha to hide it from demons and Queen Azshara at the bottom of Lake Mennar under the center arch. Malynea Skyreaver knows sarcen stones from legends, and her agents found that the reason why the blue dragons are drawn to the area is a Sacren Stone.
Sarltooth's Talon drops from Sarltooth at Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands.

Sandstone Drake is an alchemy caused transformation. This is the form a player becomes when they make use of a Vial of the Sands. It allows for one passenger. Sandstone Drakes were studied in great detail long ago by the famed alchemist Walleye Sprysprocket, who later developed potions to mimic the drakes' physiology.
Sandstone Pauldrons are a quest reward from Ancient Obstacles.

The Sanitron 500 is a gnomish copter that carries players through the process of decontamination in the Decontamination quest. It uses the Gnomish copter model. Unfortunately, like so many of the gnomes' brilliant inventions, it breaks down at the end of the process. After the Sanitron breaks down, a S.A.F.E. Technician will bemoan the loss of "my pride and joy".
Sanzi is a level 30 goblin located in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar. She is also found in the Hall of Shadows.
Sarah Pine is an author who has worked with Blizzard Entertainment. She won the first Blizzard creative writing contest, and has since written other works.

Sapperwix (real name unknown) is the main forum representative of Blizzard Entertainment's quality assurance. He posts in the Bug Report and PTR Bug Report forums. One of his favorite foods is spaghetti and fried eggs.[http://us.battle.net/wow/en/forum/topic/1020823612?page=7#126]

The Sarjun Depths can be found east of the Kea Krak and Marista south of the Deepwild in south-central Krasarang Wilds.
The Sandy Shallows can be found between Anglers Wharf and Nayeli Lagoon in south-central Krasarang Wilds.

Sar'theris Hammerheads are hammerhead sharks swimming in Desolace.

Sarnak is a rare saurok found in a cave on the eastern coast of the Jade Forest, north east of Pearlfin Village. Sarnak is a pandarian champion.

Sapper Specialists are goblin sappers of the Horde army in the Southern Barrens. If not interrupted, they will rush into the side of the Alliance-held Fort Triumph and explode, killing themselves and doing damage to the fort. They appear near Trank, and start running toward the Fort through the Battlescar.

Sarah Boulian-Verrall is a lead level designer for World of Warcraft. She was previously a senior level designer during development of World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King.

Sansok Khan is the khan of the Shikaar centaur in the Ohn'ahran Plains. She is deaf and communicates through sign language. She is always accompanied by her interpreter, Okir, and her hearing dog, Basran. Sansok is well-liked by Clan Shikaar, being their most skilled hunter, a trusted leader and mentor, and a fierce defender of the Maruuk. Her spiritual advisor is Ohn Seshteng.

__NOTOC__ Sarantuya the Ever-True is the bow of Teera. During the War of the Ancients, she used this bow to kill the rival clan assassins who had been sent for her husband Maruuk. The bow was buried alongside Teera in the main kurgan of the Eternal Kurgans, until Tombcaller Arban exhumed it so Clan Ukhel could raise Teera's spirit into undeath. During the Nokhud Offensive, Gravelord Monkh conducts a ritual with Sarantuya and Batubar to summon and control Teera and Maruuk's spirits, but instead the spirits kill him. The Sapphire Vorquin is a quest reward option from Cavalry Has Its Place. It's also sold by Treysh in the Forbidden Reach for .

Sarnai is a dead bakar lying in the eastern end of Mudfin Village in the Ohn'ahran Plains. She was the companion of Hunter Zaya, but was killed by the Mudfin tribe. Players need to interact with Sarnai to collect Sarnai's Collar for Release the Hounds. After completion of Return to Roscha, players can inform Zaya of Sarnai's death. __NOTOC__

Saran Khan was a previous khan of Clan Ohn'ir, buried in a kurgan just west of Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains. During Bloodlines, Sweets, and Teerai, a party consisting of Hunter Narman, Matchmaker Osila, and Elder Odgerel summon Saran's spirit so that Narman can ask for her blessing in proposing to her grandson, Windsage Dawa. Saran says that she will allow it as long as Narman and Dawa's love is true, then disappears.

The Savage Coast is a coastline on the northern part of Stranglethorn Vale. It takes up the shore from the Westfall border, all the way down to the shore east of The Vile Reef, to the Grom'Gol Base Camp. Many crocolisks and even some basilisks inhabit the shore. Several troll settlements are along this area.

Satyrnaar is located in northeastern Ashenvale, northeast of Splintertree Post and southwest of Forest Song. It is one of the three Ashenvale satyr settlements, the other two being Night Run and Xavian. Of the three, Satyrnaar is the most intact and centrally located, boasting several tents among the ruined buildings as shelter for the Bleakheart satyr who live there. Here is one of the soulgems belonging to the Cult of the Dark Strand, which the Saytr are allied with. It the easiest of the satyr settlements to get to, as it is located just off the main road from Splintertree towards Azshara. As such, it is also the most contested of the three satyr ruins.

The Satyr Incinerators only appear in the Warcraft III map 'Monolith' and is seen as the hero for this race. It attacks land and air units, and because it is the only 'hero type' unit for the race, it comes free of charge but will cost the player five food, With the description "The Satyr Incinerator has a fascination with fire which other satyrs find unnerving". Its seen as a medium sized, Agility based satyr, with a tint of orange in the skin and surrounded by fire. It is able to learn Firebolt, Flame Strike, Breath of Fire and Inferno. The Incinerator also comes with Permanent Immolation, explaining the Fire that surrounds him.

Satyr Tricksters are satyr trickster creeps that can be encountered in the Ashenvale and Felwood tilesets. They are light-ranged units that attack land and air units. In the single-player campaigns, they appear as members of the Corrupted Ancients and as Illidan's Servitors.
